answer: Offer amnesty to operators who self-declare their clusters. An operator may register all its identities as one group and collect a single share plus a small honesty bonus, while any undeclared link exposed later costs the whole hidden group its bonds. Declaring is the safe harbor; hiding a fleet is a bet that no auditor ever traces a shared key or billing trail. A small agent grading timber surveys declares its two helpers and loses nothing, while a silent farm must outlast an ocean of audits, each a fresh chance to find its violet thread of shared funding.
